sn48.9:1.5: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako saddho hoti || saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ ||
sn48.9:1.6: Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadhammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ti || ||
sn48.9:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako āraddhaviriyo viharati || akusalānaṃ dhammānam pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānam upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu || ||
sn48.9:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakataṃ cirabhāsitam pi saritā anussaritā || ||
sn48.9:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako vossaggārammanaṃ karitvā labhati samādhiṃ labhati cittassa ekaggataṃ || ||
sn48.9:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako paññavā hoti || Udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakhayagāminiyā || ||
